title: Buche einen Bluttest vor Ort
seoTitle: Book a blood test on site - DoctorBox Heimtests
seoDescription: Book your on-site blood test now – fast, safe, and professional. Our partner labs will perform the analysis, and you'll receive your results digitally within 24 hours.
html:
Welcome!

With DoctorBox Lab, we give you the opportunity to get an STI test at our partner lab in Berlin. You’ll receive your results within 24 hours.

Simple, transparent, and fast results.

Our services on site

  • STI XL

    Comprehensive test

    Urine and blood test

    Panel:

    • Chlamydia
    • Gonorrhea
    • Trichomoniasis
    • Mycoplasma genitalium
    • Mycoplasma hominis
    • Ureaplasma parvum
    • Ureaplasma urealyticum
    • HIV (Screening)
    • Syphilis (Lues) (Screening)
    • Hepatitis C (Screening)


    Recommended for:     Individuals seeking a comprehensive screening or who have had a high risk exposure.

  • STI M

    Urine and blood test

    Panel:

    • Chlamydia
    • HIV (screening)
    • Syphilis (Lues) (screening)
    • Hepatitis C (screening)


    Recommended for: People with risk contacts who also want to be tested for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis C.

  • STI S

    Urine sample

    Panel:

    • Chlamydia
    • Gonorrhea
    • Trichomoniasis
    • Mycoplasma genitalium

Find us here

We offer you a wide range of on-site tests—from sexually transmitted diseases to cholesterol and PSA.

All tests are performed via venous blood draw, meaning a classic blood sample taken from the arm vein by medical professionals.

The Berlin location:

MVZ Laboratory Medicine Berlin

Drs. Wisplinghoff and Colleagues,

Ostseestr. 111, 10409 Berlin

Overview of services and booking

Booking and process

Have your blood values checked easily, safely, and professionally—without long wait times. Simply book an appointment at a partner lab or a nearby practice through our platform.

How it works:

  1. Select an appointment – Find the right location and an available time online.
  2. Blood draw on site – The sample is collected by qualified medical staff.
  3. Receive results digitally – You’ll get your evaluation quickly and securely online.

Your benefits

  • Professional analysis by certified laboratories
  • Fast results delivered directly to your personal account
  • Easy appointment booking without phone calls or paperwork
  • Discreet & secure – your data is protected
Book an appointment now
